title: Police Blotter: 14 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Fourteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on November 14 and 15, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds — DWI, assault, theft, resisting arrest and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Fourteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Saturday, November 14, and Sunday, November 15, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Alexis Cabrera

Alexis Cabrera was arrested on Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 1:52 a.m. on an alleged charge of theft of property valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $2,010. The booking record also shows an out-of-county/state hold. Cabrera was released on bond on Sunday, November 15, 2026. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Zindy Jocelin Quiroz

Zindy Jocelin Quiroz was arrested on Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 11:19 p.m. on alleged charges of assault causing bodily injury — family member, a Class A misdemeanor, and criminal mischief valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,000 on the assault charge and $500 on the criminal mischief charge. The booking record also shows an immigration hold by Homeland Security. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Alejandro Alberto Lopez-Martinez

Alejandro Alberto Lopez-Martinez was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 4:23 a.m. on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,500. He was released on bond on Sunday, November 15, 2026. He was arrested by the Department of Public Safety.

Raul Parra-Castro

Raul Parra-Castro was booked on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 6:45 a.m. on a federal violation hold. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The holding agencies were the United States Marshals Service and U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

Rosa Isela Bolanos-Aguilar

Rosa Isela Bolanos-Aguilar was booked on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 7:01 a.m. on a federal violation hold. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The holding agency was U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

John Michael Rocha

John Michael Rocha was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 7:26 a.m. on alleged charges of assault causing bodily injury — family member, a Class A misdemeanor; terroristic threat of family or household, a Class A misdemeanor; and criminal mischief valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $40,000 on the assault charge, $10,000 on the terroristic threat charge and $3,000 on the criminal mischief charge. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Miriana Zazueta

Miriana Zazueta was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 9:24 a.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury — family member, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Dania Esmeralda Cruz

Dania Esmeralda Cruz was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 11:32 a.m. on an alleged charge of assault causing bodily injury — family member, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The booking record also shows an immigration hold by Homeland Security. She was arrested by the Webb County Sheriff's Office.

Maury Estefany Tijerina-Rodriguez

Maury Estefany Tijerina-Rodriguez was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 12:25 p.m. on alleged charges of driving while intoxicated with a blood alcohol concentration of 0.15 or higher, a Class A misdemeanor, and resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $1,500 on the driving while intoxicated charge and $1,000 on the resisting arrest charge. She was released on bond on Sunday, November 15, 2026. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Jose Alberto Castanon Mora

Jose Alberto Castanon Mora was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 3:09 p.m. on an alleged charge of violation of a bond or protective order, a Class A misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Oscar Esteban Luna

Oscar Esteban Luna was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 4:57 p.m. on an alleged charge of making a false statement to a peace officer, special investigator, law enforcement employee or correctional officer, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,000. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Paola Dennise Ramirez

Paola Dennise Ramirez was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 7:30 p.m. on an alleged charge of resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $6,000. The booking record also shows an out-of-county/state hold. She was arrested by U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

Adrian Torres-Mata

Adrian Torres-Mata was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 7:38 p.m. on an alleged charge of theft of property valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Jose David De-Luna

Jose David De-Luna was arrested on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at 10:54 p.m. on alleged charges of organized retail theft valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class A misdemeanor, and theft of property valued at $100 to less than $750, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
